name: smithers
description: Drive Smithers, the durable control plane for long-running coding agents: run, watch, approve, and resume workflows, and build a live custom UI for every run.

interface.shortDescription: Durable, resumable AI workflows with a live UI
interface.longDescription: Smithers is a durable control plane for long-running coding agents. This plugin lets Codex run Smithers workflows, watch them to completion, clear approval gates, resume after crashes, and author a first-class custom UI (built on smithers gateway-react) for every workflow so the human can watch the run live.
defaultPrompt: List the Smithers workflows available in this repo.
Build a Smithers workflow that implements this and reviews it, give it a custom UI, and run it so I can watch.
